message: Hey Jane, how's the semester treating you? I heard there were some tough midterms. Are your students keeping up?
Jane, don't forget about our book club meeting next Thursday!
Reminder: Faculty meeting tomorrow at 10 AM in the main conference room.
Good news! The recent projects have shown a noticeable improvement in class performance. Well done to all faculty and students!
Noted Emily's midterm grade: C-. Must provide additional support to ensure her success in the final exams.
